text:
anya: Quick sync — I'm onboarding sable-14b to the catalog. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/sable-14b/v1/; can someone confirm checksum? Also seeing tokenizer quirks: emojis get split into two tokens which is throwing off our prompt-length accounting in the perf harness. Config validation failing on `warmup_steps` (schema says int, got 'auto').

 darren: I'll validate the checksum in a sec. Can you paste the exact tokenizer version? HF has a few variants.

 anya: using `sable/tokenizer` v0.2.1 (from model artifacts). Example tokenization: `tokenizer.encode("Hi 🙂") -> [154, 2, 301]` (emoji split). 

 ciara: quick note — the tokenizer was ported from byte-level BPE. The fast tokenizer handles emojis differently. Try `use_fast=True` or run `tokenizer.normalizer = None` to compare. Also we added `emoji_aware` patches in v0.2.3, maybe re-generate tokenizer? :thinking_face:

 zane: I ran a smoke perf on a single p4d with seq_len=1024, batch=1..8. Raw numbers:
``
batch=1: 140ms p95 / token
batch=2: 95ms p95 / token
batch=4: 68ms p95 / token
batch=8: 62ms p95 / token
```
Throughput improved but tail latency stayed around 60ms when batching. Command used:
```
./bench/run_bench.sh --model s3://redwood-models/sable-14b/v1 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --iter 200
```

 benchbot: automated checkpoint: perf-run 1774001500 completed. Attached artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1774001500. CI status: flaky for batch>=8 due to OOM on 16GB NVMe cache. :warning:

 anya: thanks zane — can you drop the perf artifacts link here? Also, PR for config fixes is up (https://git.redwood/infer/configs/pull/612) — needs reviewers.

 zane: artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1774001500/artifacts.tar.gz

 darren: checked checksum: md5 = 9a1b3e7f6c2d8b9e. Matches uploaded manifest. For the config schema, change `warmup_steps: "auto"` -> `warmup_steps: 200` as short-term. I'll leave a comment in the PR.

 ciara: for tokenizer, short plan: 1) try `use_fast=True` and re-run smoke 2) if mismatch persists, recompile tokenizer with emoji-aware normalizer and push v0.2.3. I can do step 1 now.

 anya: assigning tasks — @ciara try step 1 and post results, @zane run batch sweep 1..16 and include p50/p95/p99 in the artifact, @darren merge the config fix after two approvals. We'll canary the model at 5% for 12h before full catalog publish. :white_check_mark:

 zane: starting sweep now. Will upload summary CSV to the artifacts bucket. ETA ~45m.

 ciara: quick result: `use_fast=True` reduces emoji split — `tokenizer.encode("Hi 🙂") -> [154, 301]`. Re-running small smoke now.

 benchbot: perf summary (intermediate): avg p95 at batch=4 decreased from 68ms -> 64ms after tokenizer fix. Full sweep ongoing.

 anya: thanks all. If sweep looks clean, I'll start canary rollout tomorrow morning. Ping me in thread when artifacts are ready. :rocket:
